name: zclass_object3d_set_visible_flag
description: zClass_Object3D::gwObject3DSetVisibleFlag sets or clears the Object3D visible flag after validating the node contract.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Final byte matching should be handled with the coherent zClass Object3D source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x44dbb0 validates null-node and null-class-data return 5 paths, wrong-class return 3, Object3D class id 5, flag bit 0x04 set when visible is nonzero, flag bit 0x04 clear when visible is zero, and success return 0.
The native Object3D visible/color smoke verifies setting and clearing the visible flag plus null-node and wrong-class error returns.
